purpose: Decorative stage-selection background; encounter actors, stage platforms, labels and clouds are separate runtime layers.
rendering: Preserve the 2:3 aspect ratio. Use the full artwork width as the map width. Place stage platform centers at the anchors and place actor feet on their stage platforms.
repeat: Both borders continue through a broadly centered road. This is visually repeatable but not pixel-seamless. Stack copies in the same orientation, overlap about 5 percent of image height, use a short alpha crossfade and existing cloud art around outer seam edges. Do not vertically mirror stairs. Keep center-road cloud opacity light.
